title: 1 node with habana.ai/gaudi has no utilisation source
evidence: Node/gaudi-1: 8 × habana.ai/gaudi (dl1.24xlarge), no metrics source runs on it

fix.summary: Install the Intel Gaudi Prometheus metric exporter as a DaemonSet on the Gaudi nodes, then re-run `forge ml discover` to adopt it.

title: 1 node with example.com/fpga has no utilisation source
evidence: Node/fpga-1: 2 × example.com/fpga, no metrics source runs on it

fix.summary: forge knows no exporter for this resource, so it shows allocation only. Install the device vendor's exporter and adopt it in ml.k with forge.Adopt (selector, port, allow).

title: 1 node with aws.amazon.com/neuroncore has no utilisation source
evidence: Node/trn1-1: 32 × aws.amazon.com/neuroncore (trn1.32xlarge), no metrics source runs on it

fix.summary: Run neuron-monitor with its Prometheus exporter as a DaemonSet on the Neuron nodes, then re-run `forge ml discover` to adopt it.

title: 1 accelerator Job skips Kueue's quota
evidence: Job/research/gaudi-smoke: 1 × habana.ai/gaudi per pod, no kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name label

fix.summary: Add the label kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: <LocalQueue> to each Job. (Unless Kueue's manageJobsWithoutQueueName is on, which discovery cannot read.)

title: 3 nodes had idle, unrequested accelerators at snapshot time
evidence: pool (no pool label): Node/fpga-1: 2 × example.com/fpga allocatable, none requested
pool (no pool label): Node/gaudi-1: 8 × habana.ai/gaudi allocatable, none requested
pool (no pool label): Node/tpu-v5e-1: 4 × google.com/tpu allocatable, none requested

fix.summary: One snapshot is not a trend. If these nodes stay unrequested, lower the pool's minimum size in its autoscaler (cluster autoscaler, Karpenter, the cloud's node pool) so it scales down.

title: Kubelet tracing may be off on 5 self-managed accelerator nodes (unverified)

fix.summary: Discovery cannot read the kubelet's config (it never requests nodes/proxy), so check it: if KubeletConfiguration has no `tracing` block, add one (GA in Kubernetes 1.34) pointing at your OTLP collector, to see image pull and container start spans. Dismiss this finding once it is on.

dismissed.reason: lab nodes export kubelet traces already
